title: Add an SSD to your PS5
subtitle: PS5 Slim & Pro · 8 steps
steps: Turn it off, unplug it, touch metal to remove static
Move the spacer to your SSD's length
Slide the SSD in at an angle
Press it down and screw it in
Turn it on and format the SSD
outro: Only a supported PCIe Gen4 M.2 SSD with a heatsink. Original PS5? Steps differ: see Sony's guide.
